hyperedges.description: OpenCodeSession delegates all lifecycle signals to SessionStateMachine as the single source of truth and uses DisposableStore for unified cleanup of timers, subscriptions, and abort listeners.
The event adapter classifies wire events into hard terminal vs soft close types; the state machine consumes these distinctions to decide whether a transport closure is an error or a valid transition.

The backend maintains a SessionStateMachine for protocol lifecycle while the webview maintains a Redux-like SessionState reducer driven by WebviewMessages, creating two complementary state representations that never directly reference each other.

hyperedges.label: Shared inactivity timeout pattern across transports
